verdict.rationale: Synctera's own materials indicate it is not the charter holder. It is a platform that connects founders with banks in its network and supports collaboration between the founder and a bank partner, so the sponsor-bank model is visible at a high level. Nothing names the chartering banks, clarifies whether the founder holds a direct relationship with the partner bank or sits behind middleware, or explains what happens to customers and funds if Synctera fails. Missing for 10: named partner banks/charter holder, explicit direct-vs-middleware contractual structure, platform-failure/customer-fund continuity disclosures, independent corroboration.
